cover.title: 5 niche ways to catch the errors only translated pages cause

inner.title: search for removechild
inner.body: when chrome translates a page it can swap bare text for font tags, and react then throws 'failed to execute removechild' (react issue 11538, opened 13 nov 2017). your visitor sees a broken page and most won't write to tell you.

inner.title: wrap loose text
inner.body: the top fix in that thread is putting adjacent conditional text inside a span so the node stays where react expects it. one unwrapped line can take the whole page down.

inner.title: stop waiting for a patch
inner.body: the thread has 37 comments, and on 30 aug 2018 maintainers said they couldn't fix it without tradeoffs. nobody upstream is coming to save your checkout.

inner.title: price the notranslate fix
inner.body: one commenter warns that switching translation off hurts accessibility, and a meta tag only hides the prompt, not the right-click option. a half fix with a real cost.

inner.title: keep google's translation
inner.body: google may show translated titles and snippets in 21 languages (docs updated 10 dec 2025), and a notranslate rule opts you out of all of it. hiding from translation to fix a bug quietly costs you readers.

closer.HEADLINE:
you write in one language.
they read in another.
closer.SUBLINE: the bug only shows up when someone reads you in their own words.
